title: Advanced Professionalism in Kinesiology
description: Focuses on preparation for professional practice through aspects of health professional bioethics/code of conduct, 50 hour practicum with reflective practice, charting/professional reports, evidenced-based seminar, career planning, as well as resume development.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EPHE 447, PE 447.
